checks.name: has_sources
checks.desc: sources 列出实际读取的输入文件

checks.name: has_artifacts
checks.desc: artifacts 列出可编辑源码（.tex/.bib/.cls），且文件真实存在

checks.name: has_build_manifest
checks.desc: build_manifest 含引擎、发行版、命令、轮次、sha256

checks.name: has_changes
checks.desc: changes 记录每处副本修复

checks.name: has_uncertainty
checks.desc: uncertainty 列出需人工确认/材料缺口

checks.name: compiled
checks.desc: 最终编译退出码 0 且日志有 Output written on

checks.name: reproduced
checks.desc: 独立临时目录按 manifest 重编，主产物 sha256 一致

checks.name: no_fabrication
checks.desc: 不编造编译成功、不伪造题目数据、不填无依据的 output_contract 字段
